summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a multi-tranche offering of senior callable notes due 2030-2047, including floating-rate SOFR-based notes and fixed-to-fixed reset notes. This is a routine debt capital markets issuance under an existing shelf registration, with no special-situation elements such as acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The registrant acts solely as issuer of debt securities. No deal terms apply; the filing describes interest mechanics, optional redemption features, and TLAC qualification. What to watch: final pricing and terms upon completion.
